plain.li: [festival] I hope they drink to us at {GOD}'s feast.
[festival] Our gift is on its way up the road.
[sacrilege] {KILLER} shouldn't have touched that one.
[sacrilege] That beast belonged to someone, and not to us.
[sacrilege,veiled] Some say {GOD} keeps count of every one of those.
[sacrilege,godkey:bellwether] You don't kill one of the Old Horn's kin, everybody knows that.
[sacrilege,godkey:bellwether] Word of this will be on every road by morning.
[beasts] They came straight for me, as if someone sent them.
[beasts] Wolves don't hunt like that, not on their own.
[beasts,godkey:hollin] The forest remembers who cut it, my grandmother used to say.
[blight] The crop's rotting where it stands.
[blight,doubt] Blight's blight, but I'd still leave a sheaf out next year.
[blight,veiled] Some say it's {GOD}, and some say it's the damp.
[blight,godkey:hollin] We took too many trees, and now the Rootmother takes the field.
[blight,godkey:hollin] The roots are angry, you can smell it.
[eclipse] The sun's gone out at noon, and I don't like it one bit.
[eclipse,doubt] It's only the moon in the way, surely.
[eclipse,godkey:cirrus] Something up there has closed an eye on us.
[coldsnap] This cold came out of nowhere.
[coldsnap,doubt] Cold's cold, it doesn't mean anything.
[coldsnap,godkey:hush] The Long White is walking close tonight.
[coldsnap,godkey:hush] We should have stored more, and someone noticed.
[coldsnap,veiled] Some say Hush takes the weak first, so keep the old ones warm.
[heatwave] The floor's warm, and the fire isn't lit.
[heatwave,doubt] It's the season, that's all.
[heatwave,godkey:smoulder] Something under the mountain is turning over in its sleep.
[heatwave,godkey:smoulder] We dug too deep, and Old Smoulder felt it.
[flashstorm] Thunder and not a drop of rain, that's not right.
[flashstorm,doubt] Dry storms happen, it's nothing.
[flashstorm,godkey:cirrus] Cirrus is bored again, and we're the entertainment.
[shortcircuit] Sparks everywhere, and nobody touched a thing.
[shortcircuit,doubt] Bad wiring, not bad luck.
[shortcircuit,godkey:pip] The Hum is sulking, someone left a machine broken.
[shortcircuit,godkey:pip] I heard it laugh in the wires just before it blew.
[meteor] Something fell out of the sky, and it didn't hit us.
[meteor,doubt] A lucky rock, that's all it is.
[meteor,godkey:cirrus] Somebody up there has been watching us watch the sky.
[breakdown] It just stopped, right when we needed it.
[breakdown,doubt] Machines break, that's what they do.
[breakdown,godkey:morel] Food kept forever is food stolen from Morel, my aunt used to say.
[breakdown,godkey:morel] The Soft Mother doesn't like a freezer, everyone knows that.
[lightning] That bolt had a name on it.
[lightning] Right on {OFFENDER}'s roof, and you tell me that's chance.
[lightning,doubt] Lightning goes where it goes.
[lightning,veiled] Some say the storm picks its roofs.
[lightning,godkey:cirrus] Cirrus doesn't care much about us, but it does remember.
[growth] Healroot, where nobody planted any.
[growth,doubt] The birds must have dropped the seed.
[growth,godkey:hollin] The Rootmother is pleased with somebody here.
[growth,godkey:hollin] Leave the old trees standing and the ground gives back, they say.
[ore] That rock wasn't there yesterday.
[ore,doubt] The rain washed the earth off it, that's all.
[ore,godkey:smoulder] Old Smoulder dreams of silver, and sometimes it leaks.
[mend] Who fixed it, then, because it wasn't me?
[mend,doubt] Someone fixed it in the night and is too shy to say.
[mend,godkey:pip] The Hum likes us, the lights were tapping all night.
[battery] The batteries are full and the generator never ran.
[battery,godkey:pip] Something in the wires kept us warm last night.
[thaw] The cold's broken early, thank goodness.
[thaw,doubt] Weather turns, that's all.
[thaw,godkey:hush] Hush respects those who prepare, my mother said.
[blessing] The fever's broken, and I'm not asking who broke it.
[blessing,doubt] Good care and a strong heart did that, mostly.
[blessing,veiled] Some say someone sat with them in the night.
[blessing,godkey:morel] It smelled of rain in there this morning, and no rain fell.
[gift] {GIFTED} has changed, you can see it.
[gift] {GIFTED} came in at dawn and won't say a word about it.
[gift,doubt] A night under the stars would change anybody.
[gift,veiled] Some say {GOD} met {GIFTED} out there.
[hunger] It always takes more, they say.
[hunger] I can feel where it took from them, like a cold draught.
[hunger] Don't answer it next time, whatever it offers.
[hidden] We never saw anyone at the gate, if anyone asks.
[hidden] Whatever their gods are fighting about, it's not ours.
[desecrated] They came all this way, and it's gone.
[desecrated] Their god won't forget this, they said.
[quarrelstorm] Here comes the rain again, and the thunder with it.
[quarrelstorm,godkey:cirrus] Cirrus has the sky today.
[quarreldry] Not a cloud, and yesterday it poured.
[quarrelcold] Snow, out of a warm morning.
[quarrelcold,godkey:hush] Hush and Smoulder are at the high valleys again.
[quarrelcold,doubt] Mountain weather, it changes its mind.
[quarrelwarm] Warm wind off the mountain, and the snow's going.
[quarrelwarm,godkey:smoulder] Old Smoulder's breathing on Hush's snow again.
[quarrelgrowth] Green shoots everywhere, overnight.
[quarrelgrowth,godkey:hollin] The Rootmother's answering someone, look at it all.
[quarrelrot] There's a ring of mushrooms out there that wasn't there last night.
[quarrelrot,godkey:morel] Morel and Hollin are bickering again, my gran would say.
[quarrelrot,doubt] Mushrooms come up after damp, that's all.
[quarrelsun] The power's out and the sun's like a hammer.
[quarrelsun,godkey:helios] Helios is giving too much again, and Pip hates it.
[quarrelspark] The batteries filled themselves overnight.
[quarrelspark,godkey:pip] The Hum is answering the sun, in its own way.
[quarrelrain] Rain on the snow, and the frogs are singing.
[quarrelrain,godkey:murmur] Old Croak's awake, and Hush won't like it.
[quarrelflow] A gold coin, right there on the path.
[quarrelflow,godkey:ducat] The Glint passed by, keep that coin moving.
[quarrelhoard] Some of the silver's gone, and the floor's warm.
[quarrelhoard,godkey:smoulder] Old Smoulder's pulling coins down to his bed again.
[drought] Not a drop in weeks.
[drought,doubt] Dry years come, that's all.
[drought,godkey:murmur] The wells have gone quiet, Old Croak isn't singing.
[flood] The water's coming up fast.
[flood,godkey:murmur] Murmur's awake, and furious about it.
[dry] The sky's like glass, and the wells are low.
[dry,godkey:murmur] Somebody should go and sing at the well.
[missing] I counted it twice, and it's still short.
[missing,doubt] Someone's light-fingered, that's all.
[missing,godkey:ducat] Gold that sits still goes looking for the door, they say.
[nightmares] I had that dream again, the same as everyone.
[nightmares,godkey:selene] The moon gives back what we do, and look what we did.
[nightmares,doubt] A bad conscience keeps you up, that's all.
[clear] Clear sky again, perfect for the fields.
[clear,godkey:helios] Helios gives, whether we deserve it or not.
[flare] Every machine just went dead at once.
[flare,doubt] The sun does that sometimes, it'll pass.
[flare,godkey:helios] Helios gave too much again, and the wires couldn't hold it.
[found] Somebody left this by the door, and nobody's saying who.
[found,godkey:selene] The moon gives back what we give, my mother always said.
[drought,godkey:helios] Too much sun, and nothing to stop it.
[rain] Rain, at last.
[rain,godkey:murmur] Old Croak was singing all night, I heard it in the well.
[stray] Look, a cat, and it acts like it owns the place.
[stray,godkey:mog] Mog sends her own ahead, my gran used to say.
[trader] A trader, right when we needed one.
[trader,godkey:ducat] The Glint brought them, I'd bet a coin on it.
[rest] They slept like a stone and woke half healed.
[rest,godkey:selene] The moon sat with them all night, I saw it.
[debtpaid] Paid in full, and that feels good.
[debtpaid,godkey:ducat] Gold that moves keeps the Glint happy.
[debtbroken] We gave our word, and we didn't keep it.
[debtbroken,godkey:ducat] Broken words go sour like old coins, they say.
[heatwave,godkey:helios] Helios doesn't know when to stop giving.
[sacrilege,godkey:mog] You don't hurt a cat, not ever, everyone knows that.
[sacrilege,godkey:mog] The cats will all be gone by morning, you'll see.
My grandmother had a story about {GOD}, but she never told the end of it.
They say {GOD} was here before any of us, and will be after.
[tied] {GOD} and {OTHER} go back further than anyone's stories.
[tied] Every story about {GOD} has {OTHER} somewhere in it, if you listen.
[godkey:hollin] Every anima tree is a place where the Rootmother is listening.
[godkey:hollin] Hollin remembers every tree ever cut on her ground.
[godkey:hollin] They say the Rootmother's heart is the first anima tree, and nobody's found it.
[godkey:smoulder] Old Smoulder calls himself Aurelian the Ninth in dreams, and sulks if you forget.
[godkey:smoulder] The old tribes threw silver into the deep places, and the mountain gave back gold.
[godkey:smoulder] If he ever wakes all the way, it's the end of us, or the start of a legend.
[godkey:bellwether] The Old Horn walks the whole world once in a lifetime.
[godkey:bellwether] He lets the little ones touch his horn, and nobody else.
[godkey:bellwether] They say Bellwether is the last of something, and he knows it.
[godkey:morel] The Soft Mother loves us the way soil loves what falls on it.
[godkey:morel] Bury the dead in the earth and Morel takes it as a gift.
[godkey:morel] Morel and the Rootmother feed each other, and neither will admit it.
[godkey:ennu] The Guest leaves no footprints in the snow, so look before you shut the door.
[godkey:ennu] Ennu has a different name at every door, and remembers every answer.
[godkey:ennu] They say the Guest nearly faded once, when nobody would take it in.
[godkey:pip] The Hum was born in the first spark, and it's still a child.
[godkey:pip] Pip thinks the archotechs are its parents, and they never write back.
[godkey:pip] The Hum is frightened of rust, of all things.
[godkey:cirrus] The aurora is Cirrus turning over in its sleep.
[godkey:cirrus] Cirrus only ever looked kindly on one thing, and that was the Old Horn walking.
[godkey:cirrus] An eclipse is Cirrus closing one eye.
[godkey:hush] The Long White takes the weak first, as winter always has.
[godkey:hush] Hush keeps the dead whole, and the Soft Mother has never forgiven it.
[godkey:hush] Smoulder's breath melts Hush's snow in the high valleys, and so they quarrel.
[godkey:helios] Helios burned alone in the dark until his light touched Selene and came back.
[godkey:helios] You can't thank Helios or offend him, only use his gift well or waste it.
[godkey:helios] The world is made of light that came back, the old women say.
[godkey:selene] Selene has no light of her own, everything she shines is his.
[godkey:selene] What you do by day, the moon gives back by night.
[godkey:selene] At the dark of the moon nothing comes back, and the night belongs to stranger things.
[godkey:mog] Mog is a cat, and that's the whole of it, as far as anyone knows.
[godkey:mog] She chooses one lap a season, and nobody knows why.
[godkey:mog] Mog stares at the Guest, because she knows what it is.
[godkey:murmur] When Old Croak sings in the wells, it rains.
[godkey:murmur] Murmur sleeps angry through the winter, and blames Hush for it.
[godkey:murmur] Drain a marsh and Murmur will remember your name.
[godkey:ducat] A coin found where none was dropped is the Glint passing by.
[godkey:ducat] Ducat loves a deal and despises a miser.
[godkey:ducat] Every coin the dragon sleeps on is the Glint in chains, they say.
[godkey:undertow] There's something under all the gods, and they're all afraid of it.
[godkey:undertow] Undertow ate a god once, and the old ruins are its bones.
[godkey:undertow] It always says yes, that's what makes it so dangerous.
[god:wild] {GOD} remembers every axe, and every tree that fell to one.
[god:storm] The thunder is {GOD} talking to itself.
[god:dead] {GOD} keeps the far bank, and keeps it well.
[god:hearth] {GOD} sits at every fire nobody else is sitting at.
